description: This Java class 'MappingStrategiesBuilder' provides a fluent API to build a map of JSON deserialization strategies for various types, mainly used for handling different JSON signals and objects within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes methods to add strategies based on class types, class names, and registries, and initializes with common types like 'DittoHeaders', 'ShardedMessageEnvelope', 'SimpleCommand', and acknowledgment types.

classes.name: MappingStrategiesBuilder
classes.description: A builder class for creating a map of JSON deserialization strategies for different object types, supporting method chaining and initialization with common types.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of MappingStrategiesBuilder with default strategies added.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a JSONParsableRegistry to the builder, registering its types and parse functions.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a JSON deserialization strategy for a class, using the class's simple name as the key.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a JSON deserialization strategy for a class with a BiFunction, using the class's simple name as the key.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a JSON deserialization strategy for a type string, with a Function<JsonObject, Jsonifiable<?>>.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a JSON deserialization strategy for a type string, with a BiFunction<JsonObject, DittoHeaders, Jsonifiable<?>>.

methods.name: putAll
methods.description: Adds all strategies from a provided map to the builder.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Returns a MappingStrategies object containing all added strategies.
